summary: Iteration 51 — Tested TeamNest Dev OS Phase 1 end-to-end. All 12 pytest backend tests passed (dashboard, agents catalog, project creation+plan+backlog seeding, project list/get with embedded tasks/proposals, task CRUD+status transitions, proposal create+approve+reject+request_changes, 404/400/auth gates). All 11 Playwright UI flows passed (/you → me-dev-os row → /dev-os hub with 4 stat tiles + agents shortcut + new-project CTA, /dev-os/agents shows all 9 agents, /dev-os/new wizard fills+submits+navigates to /dev-os/projects/{id}, project detail renders plan tab + tasks kanban with backlog tasks seeded by stub plan, task-card click cycles status, Propose modal opens → submit → switches to Proposals tab → approve button works and toast shows). Stub plan fallback is in effect (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exceeded) — endpoints still return 200 with valid plan dict and at least 1 backlog task seeded, exactly as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec sheet says GET /api/dev-os/agents returns 'array of 9 agents' but the implementation returns {"agents": [...]}. Frontend (AgentsView.jsx) correctly reads r.data?.agents so it works, but the spec wording is inconsistent — consider updating either the contract docs or the endpoint to return a bare array for consistency.

POST /api/dev-projects ignores credit failures with bare `except Exception: pass` (route line 175-176, also line 273-274 for proposals). If billing fails silently, ops will not see meter drift — recommend logging the exception instead of swallowing it.
ProjectDetail.jsx PlanView card title 'Database entities' has no testid. Adding data-testid='pd-plan-card-{title}' would make plan-card assertions in future regressions easier.

Stub plan in services/dev_os_generator.py seeds exactly 1 backlog task — when the LLM is unavailable for long stretches, the project detail kanban will look sparse. Consider expanding the stub to 4-5 representative tasks (architect, frontend, backend, qa, devops) so the demo still feels populated.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test projects in demo workspace: 'TEST_iter51 Dev OS Project' (from pytest) and 'TEST_UI Dev OS project' (from UI smoke test). Both seeded ~1 backlog task each + 1 proposal each (one approved). Safe to leave; prefixed with TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dev OS endpoints are stable and stub plan fallback works as designed. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is restored, re-run test_create_project_returns_plan and verify the LLM returns a richer plan (>1 backlog task). Frontend uses HttpOnly cookie 'tn_session' via demo-login; the api lib in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js sends credentials. Two TEST_ projects exist in dev_projects collection — cleanup is optional.
